# Research Templates

- [Completion contract](completion-contract.md): minimal acceptance, negative
  closure, continuation, escalation and review terms for substantive briefs.

- [Experiment](experiment.md): planned and actual work, controls, authorization, evidence, interpretation, validation, cleanup.
- [Finding](finding.md): scoped claim with decisive support, limitations, provenance, and revisions.
- [Source](source.md): exact outside contribution and inspection/permission status.
- [Permission](permission.md): separate rights-holder and user gates for a specific use.
- [Evidence bundle](evidence-bundle.md): selected artifacts, original/derivative integrity, rights, and reproduction.

Templates are blank record forms, not approved experiments, completed reviews, or granted permissions. Allocate IDs using [EVIDENCE_STANDARD.md](../EVIDENCE_STANDARD.md). Replace every relevant placeholder and leave unknown values explicit.
